title: Fighting the system: Billboard and the phone threats
summary: After telling the trades what he was told, Monk got phone calls telling him to drop the names.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Well, that was kind of a disappointment, but you really regrouped and moved on to other things.
When did you think about the jazz society?

Well, the jazz society came because, that was like, forced you to go somewhere. You either had to give it up or go into something else. I wasn't near about to give it up. It just made me an angry man and I had to pick up arms toward that. I had to fight the system, if that's what it was. There was no question in my mind that that's what it was.

Now, I knew I had posed a threat to someone, when I was just trying to give something. That's a shame, but I had to stand for something and I knew I had to stand for that. And it all came down like this is what I had to do. Then I began to knock on other doors; I made a big issue out of that, and there was a big scene about that.
No, not a public scene. But I got threats on my phone.
Yes sir. And threats to the point that...

Because I had taken that, what he said to me, and mentioned it to the trade magazines. Billboard printed it as I said it. And I told them, repeated what they had said to me, and they put it in the trades. So naturally, that trade went around the world.

They don't need that kind of...And that's what brought the whole thing about. Because then the threats came on the phone, a couple of threats, and they were saying, 'Don't repeat any names in any more of your articles.' And another call came back making it final, 'No more names.'

In other words, they couldn't tell me not to make any more articles, but don't report any kind of things, don't repeat the names. They didn't want any more names mentioned in my articles. I didn't, at the time, it wasn't because I was trying to cut that particular person down. I was trying to cut down the attitude of the whole town. So I had no objection to that. In fact, I was...I totally agree with that.
My intention wasn't directed at that man, it was directed at the whole system. But the man said it, the system didn't say it.
